title: Lacanche — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Lacanche.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Since 1908." Luxury tier. Lacanche ranges are handmade in Lacanche, Burgundy, France since 1908. Each range is assembled by a single craftsman. Available in dozens of colors with brass, chrome, or nickel trim. Lacanche competes with La Cornue as the ultimate French range.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Ultra-luxury French kitchen builds. Competing consideration with La Cornue.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Lacanche:

• Handmade in Burgundy, France since 1908

• Each range built by a single craftsman

• Dozens of color and trim combinations

• Competes with La Cornue at slightly lower pricing

• The range serious Francophile cooks choose
